changelog.title: What's New in 7.2.6
items: Library controls redesigned: Sort By is now a row of small segmented buttons (A-Z, Z-A, Recent, Playtime, Ach)
Filters moved into a small filter-icon button on the right that opens a dropdown of switch toggles, aligned to the button
Your profile status now says "In Non-Steam Game" (and shows the title) when Steam is running a non-Steam game
2 new free themes: Sunset Drive, Deep Forest
New achievements: Variety Player (play 25 different games), Century Sessions (complete 100 tracked sessions)

news.title: SteamLite 7.2.6 — Redesigned Library Controls
news.content: Version 7.2.6 redesigns the library controls bar: sorting is now a row of small segmented buttons (A-Z, Z-A, Recent, Playtime, Ach), and all filters live behind a compact filter-icon button on the right that opens a dropdown menu of modern switch toggles. Your profile status now correctly shows 'In Non-Steam Game' with the title when Steam is running a non-Steam game. Also ships 2 new free themes (Sunset Drive, Deep Forest) and 2 new achievements (Variety Player, Century Sessions).

news.title: SteamLite 7.2.5 — Settings Overhaul & Bug Fixes
news.content: Version 7.2.5 gave Settings a dedicated Advanced Settings modal with modern switch toggles and new options, moved the accent picker to the Theme Shop, added a spinning loading overlay, calmer UI sounds, 2 new free themes and 2 new achievements, plus 8 bug fixes.
